title: Mobility and periodic registration update accepted by the network

entities.name: Mobility and periodic registration update
entities.description: Registration procedure for mobility and periodic registration update accepted by the network, where the AMF sends a REGISTRATION ACCEPT message to the UE.

entities.name: REGISTRATION ACCEPT
entities.description: Message sent by the AMF to the UE when the registration update request is accepted.

entities.name: REGISTRATION REQUEST
entities.description: Message sent by the UE to initiate the registration procedure.

entities.name: REGISTRATION COMPLETE
entities.description: Message sent by the UE to acknowledge reception of certain IEs in the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message.

entities.name: 5G-GUTI
entities.description: Globally Unique Temporary Identifier for 5G, which may be reallocated during registration procedure.

entities.name: CAG information list
entities.description: Information element containing Closed Access Group information list, included if the UE supports CAG and the AMF needs to update it.

entities.name: 5GS registration result
entities.description: Indicates the registration result, such as 3GPP access, non-3GPP access, both, or registered for emergency services.

entities.name: Allowed NSSAI
entities.description: Network Slice Selection Assistance Information allowed for the UE in the current PLMN.

entities.name: Rejected NSSAI
entities.description: Network Slice Selection Assistance Information that is rejected by the network, with associated rejection causes.

entities.name: Pending NSSAI
entities.description: S-NSSAIs for which network slice-specific authentication and authorization will be performed or is ongoing.

entities.name: Timer T3550
entities.description: Timer started by the AMF when certain IEs are included in the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message, and stopped upon receiving REGISTRATION COMPLETE.

entities.name: Timer T3513
entities.description: Timer running in the AMF, stopped if a paging request was sent with non-3GPP access type and REGISTRATION REQUEST includes Allowed PDU session status IE.

entities.name: Timer T3565
entities.description: Timer running in the AMF, stopped when a REGISTRATION REQUEST message is received.

entities.name: 5GMM-REGISTERED
entities.description: State entered by the UE upon receipt of the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message.

entities.name: 5GMM-COMMON-PROCEDURE-INITIATED
entities.description: State entered by the AMF when starting timer T3550 for common procedures.

entities.name: UE sets CAG bit to 'CAG supported'
entities.description: Condition where the UE indicates support for CAG in the 5GMM capability IE of the REGISTRATION REQUEST message.

entities.name: AMF stores UE capabilities
entities.description: AMF stores all octets received from the UE for 5GMM capability, S1 UE network capability, and UE security capability IEs.

relations.description: The registration procedure includes sending the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message by the AMF.
REGISTRATION ACCEPT message may contain the 5G-GUTI IE for reallocation.
REGISTRATION ACCEPT message may contain the CAG information list IE if the UE supports CAG and AMF needs to update it.
REGISTRATION ACCEPT message contains the 5GS registration result IE indicating the registration outcome.
REGISTRATION ACCEPT message may contain the allowed NSSAI IE for the current PLMN.
REGISTRATION ACCEPT message may contain the rejected NSSAI IE with rejection causes.
REGISTRATION ACCEPT message may contain the pending NSSAI IE for S-NSSAIs undergoing NSSAA.
The registration procedure stops timer T3513 under specified conditions.
The registration procedure stops timer T3565 when REGISTRATION REQUEST is received.
The registration procedure starts timer T3550 when certain IEs are included in REGISTRATION ACCEPT.
Receipt of REGISTRATION COMPLETE message stops timer T3550.
Upon successful registration, the UE enters state 5GMM-REGISTERED.
The AMF enters state 5GMM-COMMON-PROCEDURE-INITIATED when starting timer T3550.
Inclusion of CAG information list IE in REGISTRATION ACCEPT is guarded by the condition that UE sets CAG bit to 'CAG supported'.
Receipt of REGISTRATION REQUEST message establishes that AMF stores UE capabilities from the message.
Inclusion of certain IEs in REGISTRATION ACCEPT triggers the UE to send REGISTRATION COMPLETE.
Receipt of REGISTRATION ACCEPT message causes UE to transition to 5GMM-REGISTERED state.
